cases.question: Which month between October 2012 and October 2013 had the highest average benthic ash‑free dry mass for coarse particulate organic matter at the Till river site, and what was that average value?
cases.reference_code:
(Table_0
    .assign(_date=pd.to_datetime(Table_0['SAMPLE_DATE'], dayfirst=True))
    .loc[lambda df: (df['RIVER_NAME'] == 'Till') &
                     (df['POM_Fraction'] == 'Coarse particulate organic matter') &
                     (df['_date'] >= pd.Timestamp('2012-10-01')) &
                     (df['_date'] <= pd.Timestamp('2013-10-31'))]

cases.question: Which grade‑unit combination has the highest average salary among the top 10 senior civil servant posts in the Department for Transport in 2022, and what is that average salary?

df = Table_0.loc[

]

    overall_rank=df['Salary Cost of Reports (£)'].rank(method='min', ascending=False)
)

cases.question: Is the correlation between a 2015 BFE district’s perimeter-to-area ratio and its total area stronger among the districts with the highest ratios (top 20%) than across all districts?
cases.reference_code:
Table_0['ratio'] = Table_0['Shape__Length'] / Table_0['Shape__Area']
corr_all = Table_0[['ratio', 'Shape__Area']].corr(method='pearson').iloc[0, 1]
threshold = Table_0['ratio'].quantile(0.8)
Table_0['top20_flag'] = Table_0['ratio'] >= threshold
top20_df = Table_0[Table_0['top20_flag']]
corr_top20 = top20_df[['ratio', 'Shape__Area']].corr(method='pearson').iloc[0, 1]
Table_0['stronger'] = abs(corr_top20) > abs(corr_all)
is_stronger = Table_0['stronger'].max()
is_stronger
cases.expected_result_description: True if the absolute Pearson correlation between perimeter‑to‑area ratio and total area among the top‑20 % ratio districts is greater than the absolute correlation across all districts; otherwise False.

cases.question: Which Community Safety Partnerships (bsc) saw the biggest increase in boundary area between December 2020 and December 2023, and what was the average increase across all partnerships?

cases.question: What is the average annual total rates balance across the 2016/17 to 2025/26 period, and how does it compare to the average domestic balance over the same years?
cases.reference_code:
import pandas as pd
Table_0['TOTAL'] = pd.to_numeric(Table_0['TOTAL'].replace('[£,]', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
Table_0['DOMESTIC'] = pd.to_numeric(Table_0['DOMESTIC'].replace('[£,]', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
avg_total = Table_0['TOTAL'].mean()
avg_domestic = Table_0['DOMESTIC'].mean()
result = pd.DataFrame({'avg_total': [avg_total], 'avg_domestic': [avg_domestic]})
result['diff'] = result['avg_total'] - result['avg_domestic']
result
cases.expected_result_description: One row with three columns: avg_total (average annual total rates balance), avg_domestic (average annual domestic balance), and diff (average total minus average domestic), all expressed in pounds.
